priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Stop writing issued tokens to application logs
findings.body: Every call passes the complete authentication token to `audit`, which writes it to `console.log`. Environments that collect stdout would expose replayable credentials to anyone with log access.

findings.title: [P2] Restrict post-login redirects to trusted destinations
findings.body: When `returnUrl` can be influenced by a login request, passing it directly to `location.assign` permits redirects to attacker-controlled origins. Validate it against approved same-origin destinations before navigation.

findings.title: [P1] Redact issued tokens instead of writing them to audit logs
findings.body:
Every call to `recordIssuedToken` sends the complete authentication token to `console.log`. In environments that collect stdout, anyone with log access can recover active bearer/session tokens and impersonate users.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Do not write issued tokens to application logs
findings.body:
Every call logs the raw issued token through console.log. Browser consoles and centralized log collectors can expose this credential to users, support personnel, or log readers, enabling account takeover while the token remains valid.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Restrict post-login redirects to trusted destinations
findings.body:
The function now passes an arbitrary caller-supplied URL directly to location.assign. A crafted login flow can therefore redirect an authenticated user to an attacker-controlled origin for phishing; validate the URL and allow only approved same-origin destinations.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Stop writing issued tokens to logs
findings.body:
Every `recordIssuedToken` call sends the raw token to stdout, exposing credentials to log collectors, operators, and anyone with log access; this can enable token replay and account compromise.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
